summary: Test suite is well-structured with three tiers (unit, structure, integration) and covers core requirements in theory, but critically incomplete in execution. Major issues: (1) Fixture files (fixtures/artifacts.json, fixtures-caseB/) are referenced by tests but not provided—tests cannot run without them; (2) workflow file (.github/workflows/artifact-cleanup-script.yml) referenced by structure tests is missing; (3) edge cases severely underrepresented—no tests for empty artifact lists, zero policy values, timestamp boundary conditions, malformed artifact data, same-timestamp artifacts, or multi-workflow artifact grouping; (4) missing validation tests for shellcheck and bash -n syntax checks (required by task); (5) only 2 act test cases when more scenario coverage is needed; (6) act test code is complex and fragile (sed manipulation of workflow). Test names are clear and organization is logical, but absence of fixture definitions and inadequate edge case coverage mean this suite would miss many regressions and cannot be verified to run.
